R1.description: The correction sheet reads as board 20i draws it: its title and subtitle, then the steppers and the RPE, pain and technique rows, open whatever Extra set fields says and filled with the set's values

R2.description: Save stores changed values, clears a re-tapped cell and returns untouched values exactly as they were; Cancel saves nothing; a tapped value survives a restore

R3.description: A corrected RPE, pain or technique value is stored like a logged one and a corrected RPE changes the recommendation workout completion stores

R4.description: The sheet's hint and its Cancel and Save follow board 20i and the sheet scrolls at font scale 2.0 and in landscape; the logging screen is unchanged
